title: Sync Host Status Note
description: Writes a timestamped Kali host & network snapshot to /ext/apps_data/zero2zero/kali_status.txt on Flipper.
command: import pathlib; from z2z.netdiag import build_net_report; txt = build_net_report()['compact_text']; pathlib.Path('kali_status.txt').write_text(txt + '\n'); print(txt)
